messages.text: Let's find a deal that works for both of us: 78 P.

I can do 181. That is a fair deal for both of us.
Thanks for the offer. I can do 90 P.

I appreciate the steady movement to 93, and I'll meet you partway by coming down to 168 P. This card anchors a full album page, so its value stays well above where your offers sit today.
We both lose the longer we talk. 96 P?
I hear you on time, and I'm moving again to 162 P to keep momentum going. Show me a real step up from 96 and we can wrap this up quickly.
Fair is fair: 99 P, and we can close now.
I appreciate the step to 99, and I'm meeting you with a meaningful move down to 152 P. Your offers are still climbing in threes, though, so a bigger jump from your side is what gets this done today.
Thanks for reaching 102, and I'm stepping down again to 138 P to keep us converging. A real jump from your side, rather than another three, would let us close this today.
